job.job_description:
About the Role
Were hiring a Generative AI Engineer to build and deploy AI solutions using LLMs, diffusion models, and multimodal systems.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and fine-tune generative models (GPT, LLaMA, Stable Diffusion, etc.)
Build end-to-end GenAI pipelines (data training deployment)
Integrate LLMs using tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI APIs
Implement RAG-based solutions for enterprise use cases
Optimize model performance, cost, and latency
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stay updated with AI trends

Requirements

3+ years in ML/DL, with 2+ years in Generative AI
Strong Python skills; experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow
Hands-on with LLMs, Hugging Face, LangChain
Knowledge of embeddings & vector DBs (FAISS, Pinecone, etc.)
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and MLOps
